prompt.en: Why do you think education in early India emphasised both knowledge and moral values? How might this have benefited society? Answer in about 100 words.

label.en: Knowledge and practical skills prepared students for useful work and life

level1.en: What did the subjects and skills give a student?

clue.en: Students studied grammar, logic, mathematics, medicine and astronomy, and trained in arts and crafts. These practical skills prepared them for life.

level2Template.en: Subjects such as medicine and mathematics gave students practical ___.

label.en: Good character and moral conduct were seen as the foundation of society

level1.en: Why would a society care about the character of its students?

clue.en: Inner values such as truth, patience and humility were cultivated because good character and moral conduct were seen as the foundation of society.

level2Template.en: Good character and moral conduct were seen as the ___ of society.

label.en: Students learned their duties, which helped the family and society

level1.en: How could one student's values help other people?

clue.en: Pupils were trained to live by dharma, the guiding principle for the individual, the family and society. Fulfilling duties towards parents and teachers benefits those around them.

level2Template.en: Students learned to fulfil their ___ towards parents, teachers and others, which helped society.

text.en: Subjects and skills gave students practical ___ for life.
Good character and moral conduct were seen as the ___ of society.
Students who fulfilled their ___ helped their families and society.
